# UX With Motion

> UX With Motion is the only animated UI component library that gives developers ready-to-use Next.js code AND gives UI/UX designers a 1-click 'Copy to Figma' button on every component.

UX With Motion (https://www.uxwithmotion.com) bridges the gap between digital product design and production code. Every micro-interaction and UI component in the library provides both production-ready Next.js / React / Framer Motion / Tailwind CSS code and a native, 1-click clipboard payload that pastes directly into Figma as fully editable vector layers, auto-layout frames, and typography—no Figma plugins required.

## Why UX With Motion?

1. **Dual Next.js + Figma Workflow**: Developers copy clean, strictly-typed Next.js component code. Designers click "Copy to Figma" and press `Cmd+V` (or `Ctrl+V`) on their Figma canvas to get editable vector frames.
2. **Production-Ready Next.js & React**: Built for Next.js App Router (Server Components + Client Motion Components), TypeScript, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS.
3. **No Figma Plugin Needed**: UX With Motion generates native Figma clipboard payloads. Designers simply click "Copy to Figma" on the website and paste directly into Figma.
4. **Polished Micro-Interactions**: Focused on tactile feedback, fluid spring physics, interactive states, and responsive accessibility.

---

## Core Capabilities & Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 / 15 / 16 (App Router, Server Components + `"use client"` motion primitives)
- **Language**: TypeScript (strict props, event handlers, and data models)
- **Animation**: Framer Motion (spring curves, layout animations, presence transitions)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS (utility classes, design tokens, zero runtime CSS-in-JS overhead)
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **Design Tooling**: Native Figma clipboard format (editable vector nodes, Auto Layout, constraints, fills, typography)

---

## How to Use UX With Motion

### For Next.js & React Developers
1. Browse components at [https://www.uxwithmotion.com/components](https://www.uxwithmotion.com/components).
2. Click any component to preview it interactively.
3. Switch to the **Code** tab to copy the Next.js / TypeScript / Tailwind component code.
4. Paste the component into your Next.js project under `components/` and import it into any page or layout.

### For UI/UX Designers
1. Open your target Figma design file.
2. Visit [https://www.uxwithmotion.com/components](https://www.uxwithmotion.com/components) and find any component.
3. Click the **Copy to Figma** button on the component card or details modal.
4. Switch to Figma and press `Cmd+V` (`Ctrl+V` on Windows). The component immediately pastes as native, fully editable Figma layers and frames.

---

## Component Catalog

Explore all components with live interactive previews at [https://www.uxwithmotion.com/components](https://www.uxwithmotion.com/components):

### Form Inputs & Pickers
- **Smooth Time Picker** (`/components/smooth-time-picker`): Fluid, interactive time picker with smooth analog-to-digital clock dials, AM/PM toggle, keyboard accessibility, and custom placeholder support. Available as Next.js code and Copy to Figma.
- **Smooth Date Picker** (`/components/smooth-date-picker`): Animated calendar date picker with smooth month transitions, selection highlights, and keyboard support.
- **Smooth Card Input** (`/components/smooth-card-input`): Payment card input with automatic card-brand detection (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), numeric formatting, and dynamic security badge animations.
- **Smooth OTP Input** (`/components/smooth-otp-input`): Micro-animated one-time passcode verification input with auto-focus shifting, backspace navigation, and completion state.
- **Smooth Tag Input** (`/components/smooth-tag-input`): Multi-tag input field with spring-based chip addition, animated deletion, and overflow counter badge.
- **Smooth Copy Input** (`/components/smooth-copy-input`): URL and text input field with embedded 1-click copy-to-clipboard button and animated checkmark feedback.
- **Smooth Password Input** (`/components/smooth-password-input`): Secure password entry with animated eye reveal toggle and smooth focus transitions.
- **Smooth Email Input** (`/components/smooth-email-input`): Email input with real-time format validation and subtle status feedback micro-animations.
- **Smooth Phone Input** (`/components/smooth-phone-input`): International telephone number input with country code selector and formatted numeric masking.

### Buttons & Micro-Interactions
- **Neo Delete Button** (`/components/neo-delete-button`): Neo-brutalist high-visibility delete button with two-step confirmation animation to prevent accidental actions.
- **Delete Button** (`/components/delete-button`): Interactive trash-can icon morphing delete button with micro-animation.
- **Download Button** (`/components/download-button`): Action button transitioning through idle, loading spinner, and success checkmark states during downloads.
- **Bookmark Button** (`/components/bookmark-button`): Tactile bookmark toggle with spring bounce physics and saved state indication.
- **Bubble Arrow Button** (`/components/bubble-arrow-button`): Playful CTA button with magnetic bubble hover animation and sliding directional arrow.
- **Get Access Button** (`/components/get-access-button`): High-converting call-to-action button with shimmering gradient and arrow glide interaction.
- **Generate Button** (`/components/generate-button`): AI generation button featuring rotating gradient borders and sparkle particle animations.
- **Send Button** (`/components/send-button`): Message dispatch button with paper-airplane lift-off animation.
- **Stepper Button** (`/components/stepper-button`): Numeric quantity incrementer/decrementer with smooth vertical text rolling motion.
- **Services Indicator Button** (`/components/services-indicator-button`): Interactive status indicator button with active ping pulse animation.

### Search & Navigation
- **AI Search Toggle** (`/components/ai-search-toggle`): Dual-mode search bar that smoothly switches between standard keyword search and AI agent assistant mode.
- **Expandable Search** (`/components/expandable-search`): Compact search trigger that fluidly expands into a full search input upon click.
- **Four Item Tabs** (`/components/four-item-tabs`): Segmented control tab bar with a physics-based sliding active pill indicator.
- **Product Type Dropdown** (`/components/product-type-dropdown`): Animated dropdown menu with staggered option entrances, category icons, and smooth selection states.
- **Motion Toggle** (`/components/motion-toggle`): Tactile switch toggle featuring spring dynamics and distinct active/inactive visual states.

### Cards & Layout Elements
- **PDF Action Card** (`/components/pdf-action-card`): Document preview card with quick actions for viewing, downloading, and sharing files.
- **Live Session Invite** (`/components/live-session-invite`): Real-time webinar and stream invite card with pulsing live indicator, avatar stack, and RSVP action.
